screener._note: Hard gates for fresh_momentum: min_return_2d, min_return_5d and min_market_cap. Everything else is an OPTIONAL tightening knob, OFF by default (0 / false = informational only — still computed, displayed and scored). To re-enable as filters: raise min_price / min_rvol / min_avg_dollar_vol above 0 (e.g. 10 / 1.5 / 20e6) or set require_above_ma20/50 to true. The long_term_winners (doublers) and established_momentum buckets follow the same min_price / min_avg_dollar_vol knobs. est_min_return_20d/60d gate the established_momentum bucket (plus price > MA20 > MA50). The v3 score uses fixed absolute scaling (documented in each snapshot's analytics block) — the old score_weights key is ignored.
